HSV is computed from the hex, never stored. Hue reads on a 0–100 scale in half steps — 201 positions, 1.8° apart — with the exact degrees underneath. Pure red sits at 100; achromatic reads 0. Saturation and value stay as percentages.

Where a half step can't land on the exact hue, the shortfall is shown with the hex you'll actually get. The header toggle switches the readout and the CSV export together.
